methods.protected_selection: Existing blob paths in the baseline whose name starts with one of protected_prefixes; new files and all other paths are outside this byte comparison.
methods.byte_comparison: git ls-tree -r -z BASELINE supplies original blob IDs; git hash-object --no-filters --stdin-paths hashes actual working-tree bytes without line-ending filters. Every protected path is checked.
methods.protocol_binding: SHA-256 of actual v4 protocol bytes against the retained launch identity; SHA-256 of each of its 21 implementation files against implementation_sha256.

limitations: Checks only the explicitly selected existing baseline files; does not claim every historical file or newly integrated evidence was verified.
External payload arrays absent from the baseline checkout are outside this comparison and require archive/member/restored-file verification.
Git blob comparison is byte identity, not numerical validation. No FE solve, HP evaluation, production path, or scientific admission was run.
The ordinary binding validator and new tests are development changes outside the frozen src/config identity claim.
